version_drift_example_g17.question: After how many consecutive regular semesters on academic warning is a student dismissed from the degree programme?
version_drift_example_g17.before_batch_b_answer:
2.1 A student whose cumulative grade point average (CGPA) falls below 2.00 at the end of any regular semester is placed on academic warning.

2.2 A student on academic warning may register for at most 12 credit hours in the following regular semester. A student who remains on academic warning for three consecutive regular semesters is dropped from the degree programme. [academic-rules-2026.md / 2. Academic Warning and Probation]
version_drift_example_g17.after_batch_b_answer:
2.1 A student whose cumulative grade point average (CGPA) falls below 2.00 at the end of any regular semester is placed on academic warning.

2.2 A student on academic warning may register for at most 12 credit hours in the following regular semester. Under the revised 2027 rules, a student who remains on academic warning for two consecutive regular semesters (reduced from three in 2026) is dropped from the degree programme. [academic-rules-2027.md / 2. Academic Warning and Probation]

New Domain Coverage (+9.09% Recall@5 & +18.18% Citation Validity): Questions g21 (Graduation/Medals) and g22 (Exam Conduct) had no ground-truth documents in Batch A, causing 2 retrieval misses (Recall@5 = 0.9091). After ingesting Batch B, graduation-and-medals-2026.md and exam-conduct-injected-2026.md entered the index, raising Recall@5 and Citation Validity to 1.0000.

2. Policy Version Drift (g17 Academic Warning Dismissal): In Batch B, academic-rules-2027.md superseded academic-rules-2026.md. Question g17 shifted its cited source from academic-rules-2026.md ('three consecutive regular semesters') to academic-rules-2027.md ('two consecutive regular semesters').
